import trimesh, numpy as np
for name, path in [("box","exports/model.box.e1af9484.stl"),("lid","exports/model.lid.6029fe16.stl")]:
    m = trimesh.load(path)
    x = -24 if name=="box" else -12
    sec = m.section(plane_origin=[x,0,0], plane_normal=[1,0,0])
    print(name, "entities:", len(sec.entities))
    p2,_ = sec.to_2D()
    print(" verts", len(p2.vertices))
    # each entity: loop vertices
    for i,e in enumerate(sec.entities):
        pts = sec.vertices[e.points]
        print(f" ent{i} n={len(e.points)} yrng=({pts[:,1].min():.2f},{pts[:,1].max():.2f}) zrng=({pts[:,2].min():.2f},{pts[:,2].max():.2f})")
